name: whoosh_short
use: Quick cuts, icons flying in, fast UI animations
prompt: A short fast whoosh of air passing close by, clean and smooth, cinematic sound effect, natural wind only, no music

name: whoosh_medium
use: Scene transitions, cards sweeping across, title cards
prompt: A medium-length sweeping whoosh of air moving past from left to right, smooth swell and fade, cinematic sound effect, natural wind only, no music

name: whoosh_long
use: Slow scene changes, opening shots, chapter transitions
prompt: A long slow sweep of wind rushing past and fading into calm, smooth and wide, cinematic sound effect, natural, no music

name: swish_fast
use: Text flicks, quick swipes, fast motion blur moments
prompt: A very fast thin swish of a reed cutting through the air, crisp and short, close, no music

name: slide_in
use: Panels, lower thirds and captions sliding in
prompt: A smooth piece of linen fabric sliding quickly across a table and stopping, soft swish in, close, no music

name: slide_out
use: Panels, lower thirds and captions sliding out
prompt: A smooth piece of linen fabric pulled quickly off a table and away, soft swish out fading, close, no music

name: zoom_in
use: Camera push-ins, zooming into a detail
prompt: A rush of wind building quickly as if flying closer toward something, short rising air sweep, cinematic, natural, no music, no tone

name: zoom_out
use: Camera pull-backs, zooming out to an overview
prompt: A rush of wind quickly pulling back and away into the distance, short falling air sweep, cinematic, natural, no music, no tone

name: sand_wipe
use: Wipe transitions, revealing the next scene
prompt: A quick sweep of fine sand blown across a dry surface by a gust of wind, short hissing wipe, natural, no music

name: page_curl
use: Page-curl transitions, storybook and calendar flips
prompt: A large sheet of thick paper flipped over quickly, crisp flutter and soft landing, close up, no music
